1.0.0: Initial release: API key authentication, SendMessage, FindMessages and MakeApiCall components.
1.1.0: Added FindTemplates component and template dropdown in SendMessage.
1.4.0: FindMessages: fetch all pages internally (up to 100) and guard oversized 'array' output
1.6.0: Find components: aligned with Appmixer's official large-volume pattern - page loops stop on message-size budget and execution-time deadline (never a record cap), CSV exports stream page by page, 429 rate limits retry with backoff inside the loop, and 'one item at a time' exports checkpoint and resume until every record is emitted.
1.7.0: Error handling aligned with current Appmixer guidance: permanent API errors (4xx) cancel the run instead of being auto-retried; transient failures (408/429, 5xx, network) remain retryable.
1.8.0: SendMessage and CreateThrottleSchedule: send the X-External-Source header so the API gateway attributes requests to this integration.
1.9.0: Every component now ships the Esendex logo as an SVG icon (two components had none).
Find Contacts, Find Groups, Find Messages, Find Opt Outs and Find Templates export their output contract as ITEM_SCHEMA, with an example for each field shown in the variable picker.
Create Throttle Schedule: the billing output fields are titled Billing Details.Projected Balance / Billing Details.Currency so they can be told apart in the variable picker.
